capabilities: Set accent, heading, background, sidebar, border, text, link, code, quote and tag colors
Apply one of 11 predefined palettes or an AMOLED black mode
Configure interface, text and monospace fonts with sizes, line height and heading weights
Render callouts, quotes, tables, embeds and code as bento cards and grids
Save, load, export and import styling presets as JSON
extras: Interface language is Spanish only. Writes CSS variables onto <body> with !important to override the active theme and the Appearance accent color; disabling the plugin or the "Estilos activos" toggle restores previous values. Empty font fields fall back to the fonts set in Appearance. Settings live in data.json, exported presets in the plugin's presets/ folder and the clipboard. MIT license; authored by Daniel with Claude and ChatGPT as co-authors.
problem: Obsidian's Appearance settings offer only a single accent color and whatever the active theme provides, so changing many colors, fonts and card styling means editing CSS by hand.
